overview.description: The NYLIM U.S. Large Cap R&D Leaders ETF (LRND) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the NYLIM U.S. Large Cap R&D Leaders index. The fund tracks an index of 100 large-cap US companies selected and weighted based on the most recently reported one year research and development (R&D) spending. LRND was launched on Feb 8, 2022 and is issued by NYLIM.

data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--IndexIQ today announced plans to transfer listing of the Leaders in Research & Development ETF Suite from NYSE Arca to Nasdaq.
